alterations.description: The caption in English — the Roman ladies not only undressed but bathed in presence of slaves.
In the dancing girls house, when a person in woman’s dress brings coffee, delete Kailasam addressing him as a man and observing 'Go away. The boy is bending his body'.
Delete Manikyam’s reference to Kailasam as uncle (Mama).
When the girl is asked to hide under the bed, delete Kailasam’s statement 'If one comes to a place like this, one must be prepared for everything'.
When Kailasam explains to the girl the meaning of the word, 'durviniyogam' (improper expenditure), delete the girl’s reply 'it is like my paying you'.
Delete Kailasam’s reference to Manikyamm 'This body is for helping others (Paropakararthjam idham sariram)'.

In the court scene, delete the picture of the lady advocate and the public prosecutor walking about the court while addressing the jury. (There is no objection to brief shots where these are unavoidable for purposes of continuity).

Delete the close-up pictures of the judge sitting on the bench wearing both a bow-tie and the bands. (There is no objection to long and mid-shots of the judge in this dress, nor to the picture of Radha talking to him as a mad woman on the road when he is going in his car).
Where Radha and Veerappa are speaking, delete Veerappan's statement, 'What can the judge do when he has only ears and not eyes?'.
Approved replacement for Reel 2.
Approved replacement for Reels 15, 16 & 16d.
Approved replacement for Reel 16.
Delete Pachai asking Giri 'Was this lady your father’s concubine?' (Vappattia).
When Ramalingam enters during the conversation between Sadasivan and Chellam, delete his statement 'It has just begun even to happen'.

Delete (a) Pachai telling Neela 'Do not count me among the crows' (Kaka pasangal) and (b) The statement after Kazhuku enters on the scene, about the behaviour of the rationalistic party fellows (Pahutharivuvadhi).

When Panebavarnam says that he wants to become the father-in-law of Giri, delete the latter’s conversation 'Mamava?. You speak coarsely. (Oh! you refer to that mama. My idea was different and now I understand'.
When Chellam is relating her story to Giri and Pachai enters, delete the dialogue 'If uncomfortable questions are asked?— it is not such a learned person' (Arivali).
When Kazhuku and Giri are discussing Chellam’s absence, delete Kazhuku’s statement 'If a woman is going alone men will compete to come forward and go with her'.
When Madurai says that several people have sent letters to Indira in order to approach Kumarappa, delete Kazhuku saying 'They go by the cross-cut'.

After Valli brings the water jug for Kazhuku, delete her refusing fruits as she does not want to fill her stomach with all sorts of things, Kazhuku showing magazine pictures of women in bathing costume and referring to them as Western culture, inviting her attention to their body and saying that he has no work at that moment. After song No. 7, delete the rest of the sequence to the end of that reel, showing Valli, Kazhuku pinching her, her rebuff, his dialogue, catching her hand, the silhouette shot at the window showing her being molested, the picture of the bungalow verandah showing Valli dishevelled in the morning.
The fight between Kumarappa and Giri. The close-up shots of strangling are to be deleted.
When Amrutallingam says 'If a man and woman live separately it is...' and the reply '...in a peculiar manner'.
Voluntary deletion made in song.
